reviewers.summary: The manuscript is inconsistent with generated artifacts (claims no estimates exist), lacks essential study design elements (question, variable definitions, confounding control), and is positioned as an unbound exploratory analysis. These issues prevent any substantive interpretation or promotion.

findings.title: Manuscript claims no estimate records, but they exist in artifacts
findings.whyItMatters: Indicates manuscript not updated to reflect analysis output; undermines credibility.
findings.actionableFix: Update the limitations section to accurately reflect that estimate records are available and report key results like mean difference, p-value, and effect size.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check that the limitations section no longer says 'No estimate-like records were available...'

findings.title: No specific research question or clinical context stated
findings.whyItMatters: Without a clear question, the analysis cannot be evaluated for appropriateness or clinical utility.
findings.actionableFix: Explicitly state the research question (PICO elements) in the Introduction and link it to the analysis.
findings.deterministicVerification: Presence of a clearly stated question in the manuscript.

findings.title: Observational comparison lacks any confounding adjustment or balance assessment
findings.whyItMatters: The observed difference could be due to confounders; a simple t-test is insufficient for causal inference or even association without covariate control.
findings.actionableFix: Either incorporate covariates in a regression model or clearly state that the analysis is purely descriptive and cannot distinguish confounding. Provide baseline characteristics table.
findings.deterministicVerification: Existence of a table of baseline characteristics by group and a causal diagram or covariate adjustment plan.

findings.title: Cohort construction, eligibility criteria, and variable definitions are missing
findings.whyItMatters: Reproducibility and interpretation require knowing how the sample was derived and what the variables represent.
findings.actionableFix: Describe data source, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and operational definitions of treatment and outcome (e.g., treatment type, outcome measurement).
findings.deterministicVerification: Presence of a detailed cohort flow diagram and variable dictionary.

findings.title: Manuscript does not clearly convey the exploratory and unbound nature of the analysis
findings.whyItMatters: Readers may overinterpret the results; the 'result posture' explicitly warns against inference.
findings.actionableFix: Add a prominent statement that this is an exploratory analysis not governed by a pre-specified protocol or analysis plan, and that claims are local.
findings.deterministicVerification: Presence of the phrase 'exploratory' and 'unbound' in the limitations or abstract.

findings.title: Complete-case analysis with no missing data exploration
findings.whyItMatters: If missingness is non-random, the complete-case analysis may be biased; the manuscript acknowledges the risk but provides no diagnostics.
findings.actionableFix: Report the proportion of missing data, compare characteristics of complete vs. incomplete cases, and consider sensitivity analysis or multiple imputation.
findings.deterministicVerification: Presence of a missing data analysis section or justification for complete-case.

findings.title: Figure QA artifact appears truncated, and figure content not described in text
findings.whyItMatters: The boxplot is not referenced or interpreted in the manuscript; its quality cannot be fully assessed.
findings.actionableFix: Ensure the figure QA is complete and the manuscript includes a reference to the figure, with interpretation.
findings.deterministicVerification: Figure referenced in manuscript and QA complete.

findings.title: No comparison to existing literature or clinical significance
findings.whyItMatters: Without context, the effect size cannot be interpreted (e.g., is d=0.87 meaningful?).
findings.actionableFix: Discuss the observed effect relative to known minimal clinically important differences or prior studies.
findings.deterministicVerification: Presence of a discussion paragraph linking results to literature.

missingEvidence: Cohort eligibility criteria and data source
Missing data analysis or rationale for complete-case

reviewers.summary: The manuscript fails to report the actual statistical results, contradicts the run artifacts, and presents an unbound exploratory analysis as a study finding. Major reporting, reproducibility, and methodological gaps prevent any valid interpretation.

findings.title: Manuscript omits all key statistical results
findings.whyItMatters: The Abstract and Results sections mention only sample size, ignoring the estimated treatment effect, p-value, and confidence interval. Readers cannot evaluate the study's primary finding.
findings.actionableFix: Update the manuscript to include the Welch t-test results: means, mean difference, Cohen's d, test statistic, p-value, and confidence interval.
findings.deterministicVerification: manuscript.md abstract and results lack any numeric estimates.

findings.title: Manuscript contradicts available evidence
findings.whyItMatters: The Limitations section claims 'No estimate-like records were available for p-value/effect-size checks,' but the stats-run.json clearly contains an estimates array with p-value and effect size. This inconsistency undermines trust in the entire report.
findings.actionableFix: Reconcile the manuscript with the actual run output; remove the false statement.
findings.deterministicVerification: stats-run.json contains an 'estimates' key with p_value and cohen_d; manuscript.md says the opposite.

findings.title: Analysis is unbound and purely exploratory
findings.whyItMatters: The run's resultPosture is 'exploratory_standard_table' and cannot support paper-ready conclusions. Presenting it as a study answer is misleading and a claim-safety risk.
findings.actionableFix: Bind the run to a preregistered method-selection and AnalysisSpec, or explicitly downgrade the report to exploratory data analysis with no confirmatory claims.
findings.deterministicVerification: stats-run.json binding.status is 'unbound', resultPosture.label is 'Exploratory standard-table result'.

findings.title: Complete-case analysis without missing data investigation
findings.whyItMatters: Only 240 complete cases were used, but the original sample size, missingness proportion, and missing-data mechanism are not reported. Non-random missingness could bias the estimate.
findings.actionableFix: Report the number of excluded records, reasons for missingness, and a sensitivity analysis (e.g., pattern-mixture, multiple imputation).

findings.title: No normality or outlier diagnostics reported
findings.whyItMatters: The Welch t-test assumes approximate normality, especially with small groups. The only diagnostic is Levene's test for equal variance, which is not required. Without Q-Q plots or Shapiro-Wilk results, the validity of the p-value is uncertain.
findings.actionableFix: Provide distribution plots (histograms, Q-Q) per group and a formal normality test; discuss robustness.

findings.title: Cohort definition and variable metadata missing
findings.whyItMatters: No information on how treatment groups were defined, what outcome_cont measures, or the eligibility criteria is provided. Interpretation and replication are impossible.
findings.actionableFix: Add a detailed cohort flowchart, variable definitions, and source data description.

findings.title: No descriptive statistics beyond group means
findings.whyItMatters: Standard deviations, ranges, and quantiles are essential to assess data quality, effect-size interpretation, and potential floor/ceiling effects. Their absence prevents full evaluation.
findings.actionableFix: Include a table of descriptive statistics (N, mean, SD, median, min, max) for each group.

findings.title: No literature context or prior effect estimates
findings.whyItMatters: For interpretability, the observed Cohen's d needs benchmarking against similar studies. Omission limits the reader's ability to assess external consistency or plausibility.
findings.actionableFix: Briefly cite comparable studies or known effect sizes for this outcome–treatment pair.

missingEvidence: Full descriptive statistics (SD, percentiles) per group
Normality test results or Q-Q plots
Original sample size and missing data pattern (flowchart)
Cohort eligibility criteria and variable codebook
Figure quality assessment details (only partially available)
Content of manuscript-qa.json to understand prior warnings

reviewPanel.nextAction: Adjudicate findings and route accepted repairs back into the pipeline.
